name: Saishouji Yoshitaka
source:
A 3rd year student of St. Claus Academy, Yoshitaka is the board chairman's son. He will be the successor of one of the top 5 zaibatsu of Japan, the Saishouji Group. A returnee to Japan, he is cheerful and open-hearted. Yoshitaka is easy to get along with, and treats anybody he comes across in a frank manner. Naturally, all of this opens him to a never-ending stream of "invitations" from girls- none of which he turns down. Furthermore, he gets through all of those invitations splendidly and perfectly.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.zutto-otome.jp/memories/memories_chara/cha_yos.html]official website profile[/URL].]
